title: RectPick
description: Select items in a rectangular area and transfer them to another inventory.
body:
RectPick lets you select items in a rectangular area of an inventory and transfer them to another inventory. Here is a demo.
**Requirements**
NeoForge 1.21.1 **Installation**
1. Install NeoForge 1.21.1 2. Put the mod jar file into mod folder. **Configuration**
By default select/transfer key is C but you can configure via key bindings. **Source Code**
https://github.com/Pepton-0/RectPick
